headline: I ran an experiment where it uses Stockfish to play a game of chess, and it turns out to work incredibly fast.

media.alt: Video from the post by brok

text:
The new Jev model  by @typesafeai  is actually incredible. I ran an experiment where it uses Stockfish to play a game of chess, and it turns out to work incredibly fast.

This is a game against stockfish level 5
